title: Pure Red Dragon Archfiend
summary: Red Dragon Archfiend with the Resonators and the cards that name it, plus generic staples. The Resonator page opens this same list. The combo lines on both pages run a Bystial and Branded engine, so they use cards this list leaves out. It's built on the 2026 support: Power Vice Dragon and Darkness Resonator start without needing the Normal Summon, Crimson Gaia and The Crimson King search, Red Hypernova Dragon sits at the top, and Champion's Pulse, the newest card, brings Red Dragon Archfiend back from the Extra Deck or GY to negate and destroy a monster. The Extra Deck is all DARK Dragon Synchros, because almost every starter locks you into them.

allow.Power Vice Dragon: 2026 support that names Red Dragon Archfiend and searches Resonators.
allow.Bone Archfiend: Red Dragon Archfiend support from the Crimson set: its lock only allows DARK Dragon Synchros.

main: 2026 support. Special Summons itself if you control no monsters or only DARK Synchros, then searches a Resonator. A Red Dragon Archfiend made with it can't be destroyed by battle.
2026 support. Reveal Red Dragon Archfiend in the Extra Deck to Special Summon it; gives an extra Normal Summon of a Resonator, and sets your Tuners to Level 1.
On summon, searches a Level 4 or lower Fiend. From the GY, takes the hit when a card would be destroyed while you control Red Dragon Archfiend.
Special Summons itself while a Level 5 or higher DARK monster is out, such as Power Vice Dragon. Sent to the GY: searches a Spell/Trap that names Red Dragon Archfiend.
Special Summons itself from the hand or GY by sending a card; sends a Fiend Tuner from the Deck to move a monster's Level by 1.
Special Summons itself if you control no monsters; next to a single DARK Dragon Synchro, summons two more Resonators from the hand or Deck.
Special Summons itself while a Synchro is on the field; leaving the field, gets back another Resonator from the GY.
Normal Summoned: Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster from the hand.
Continuous Spell: searches Red Dragon Archfiend or a card that names it, flips the opponent face-down when it attacks, and revives it after a destruction.
2026 support. Adds a Level 4 or lower Fiend from the GY, or from the Deck while you control Red Dragon Archfiend; from the GY, gives it a second attack.
Discard a Resonator to search a Level 4 or lower Fiend.
While you control Red Dragon Archfiend, destroys a card when the opponent activates something; also revives a banished DARK Dragon Synchro.

2026 support. If the opponent Special Summoned this turn, revives a DARK Synchro; at three summons Red Dragon Archfiend also becomes unaffected by their effects, and at five their monsters flip face-down.

Newest support. When the opponent uses a monster effect while they control more cards than you, summons Red Dragon Archfiend or Hot Red Dragon Archfiend from the Extra Deck or GY to negate and destroy it; or ends their Battle Phase.
